exposure: Laparoscopic resection of cesarean section scar ectopic pregnancy
cohort: The study describes a 34-year-old G4P2T1 patient with a live 8-week pregnancy embedded in a previous cesarean section scar, who had undergone two previous uncomplicated cesarean sections.
finding: Laparoscopic excision of cesarean section scar ectopic pregnancy is an effective procedure for managing this condition, allowing for safe removal and repair of the uterine defect.
followup_time: N/A (followed until complete resolution of b-hCG levels)
